result.markdown: --- title: "Week 13: Methods Walk Through & Reporting LVPA" date: today format: revealjs: theme: simple slide-number: true embed-resources: true self-contained-math: true description: 'Download PDF' --- # Agenda - Methods walk through - Reporting - Rlab: run an LVPA & report on it. # Methods Walk Through Presenters: Callum, Gyan, Louis, Mike, Yuna - Lamaku > quize Methods Walkthrough LVPA 1-5 - answer the two questions for each presentation # Reporting LVPA ## Checklist: bu ild from what we have [APA JARS](https://apastyle.apa.org/jars/quant-table-7.pdf) Review the checklist. - What items from this checklist do we use for an LVPA model? ## Review an article Website > activity > W13 PDF - go through paper & identify on the checklist what the authors included & anything they missed. - work in groups - work in ## Practice: Use the final results for example 2 and write up a report on the model. Submit to Lamaku > Assignments > W12 ## Example results write-up (Ex 1) {.smaller} ::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"} We estimated the model with robust maximum likelihood (MLR) and full-information maximum likelihood to handle items missing by design (*N* = 1000 students from Great Britain). Following a two-step approach, we first fit the measurement model; the initial fit was poor (CFI = 0.854, RMSEA = 0.109), so we freed three residual covariances (`anx5 ~~ anx6`, `str6 ~~ str9`, `str5 ~~ str6`), after which fit was acceptable but imperfect, χ²(114) = 347.96, CFI = 0.927, RMSEA = 0.078, 90% CI [0.065, 0.091], SRMR = 0.069. In the structural model, Stress.Res predicted Math.Anx (*b* = -0.32, β = -0.42), and Math.Anx predicted Math.Sc (*b* = -0.45, β = -0.36). The indirect effect was β = 0.15. Constraining the direct path Stress.Res → Math.Sc to zero changed χ² by Δχ²(1) = 1.05, *p* = 0.306. Limitations: the residual covariances were data-driven, the items were treated as continuous, and school clustering and sampling weights were ignored. ::: ## Up Next - Nov 26: Thanksgiving, no class - Dec 3 & 10: Online class - lamaku > announcements > Zoom Invite

<script>
  // htmlwidgets need to know to resize themselves when slides are shown/hidden.
  // Fire the "slideenter" event (handled by htmlwidgets.js) when the current
  // slide changes (different for each slide format).
  (function () {
    // dispatch for htmlwidgets
    function fireSlideEnter() {
      const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
      });
    }

  })();
</script>
